status: pre-main delay observed; cause not established; later installed candidate qualified
observations: Initial installed package run passed archive inventory and extracted SDK build, then --version exceeded its 15-second deadline. That invocation remains failed.
Three fresh private copies also exceeded 15 seconds. One diagnostic launch exceeded 60 seconds.
One-second native samples showed only _dyld_start, no Connect frames, and 112 KiB process footprint. Code signature verification passed.
Contemporaneous syspolicyd logs include XProtect assessment activity for the diagnostic paths and network timeouts. Exact attribution of each assessment delay is not proved.

After allowing the retained copies to remain on disk, the unchanged copy launched in 10.309 seconds and an ad-hoc re-signed copy in 0.679 seconds. A newly copied, otherwise unchanged original binary then launched in 0.729 seconds. Re-signing is therefore not established as necessary and is not a packaging change.
interpretation: Samples place the observed stalls before Connect application initialization. Security-assessment activity was contemporaneous, but causation was not established. First execution is measured separately as an installation step; no system-security change is required or recommended. Earlier unrelated startup failures keep their own unresolved causes.
